Results.normalization: Exact one-loop massless pentagon in its critical dimension $D=5$: the volume of an ideal hyperbolic $4$-simplex (Davydychev--Delbourgo), a weight-$2$ harmonic polylogarithm. The dihedral angles are written as logarithms, $\arccos(-D_{ij})=-i\log W_{ij}$ with the algebraic letter $W_{ij}=-D_{ij}+i\sqrt{1-D_{ij}^2}=e^{i\theta_{ij}}$. The Cayley matrix is $Y_{ij}=\tfrac12(p_i+p_{i+1}+\cdots+p_{j-1})^2$ with massless internal lines ($Y_{ii}=0$): $p_i$ the external legs in cyclic order, $p_i^2=M_i^2$ the external masses ($M[i]$), and the multi-leg sums the Mandelstam invariants ($s_{i,i+1}=(p_i+p_{i+1})^2$). $D_{ij}$ is the polar Gram $D_{ij}=(Y^{-1})_{ij}/\sqrt{(Y^{-1})_{ii}(Y^{-1})_{jj}}$ (Gauss--Bonnet form, Bourjaily--Gardi--McLeod--Vergu, arXiv:1912.11067). Region $\det Y>0$, $|D_{ij}|\le1$. Not a dim-reg series and not a vacuum period.

source.title: A Geometrical angle on Feynman integrals

import.method: Closed-form n-gon hyperbolic-simplex volume (Davydychev-Delbourgo, hep-th/9709216); explicit weight-2 Gauss-Bonnet pentagon (BGMV, arXiv:1912.11067). resultCompressed verified to 12 digits against the NGon oracle at an in-region Cayley point.

Records.description: Establishes the one-loop n-point integral in D=n dimensions as the volume of a geodesic simplex in non-Euclidean (hyperbolic) space, the geometric interpretation underlying the whole n-gon family.

Records.authors: J. L. Bourjaily, E. Gardi, A. J. McLeod, C. Vergu
Records.description: Explicit hyperbolic-volume closed forms for the all-mass n-gon via a generalized Gauss-Bonnet theorem (the Gauss-Bonnet pentagon used here).
